name: Telluric-Skerry
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near an ancient meteor crater.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Nothing about the gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on dark crystals are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
